snippet.title: Terrible Lizards - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get Terrible Lizards on Steam: https://jtmch.co/3VKx1DS
Get on XBOX: https://jtmch.co/3U6yBRW
Get on PlayStation 5: https://jtmch.co/4quSXAr

Terrible Lizards is a first person horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate dangerous terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding.

Run, climb, swing, slide, and survive as you descend into abandoned dig sites, forgotten caverns, and monster-filled tunnels. Something down here is hunting… and it’s not alone.

Developed by WDR Studios, the team behind JT Music.

Get Terrible Lizards on Steam: https://jtmch.co/3VKx1DS
Get on XBOX: https://jtmch.co/3U6yBRW
Get on PlayStation 5: https://jtmch.co/4quSXAr
Terrible Lizards LinkTree: https://linktr.ee/wdrstudios
